description: This file defines a 'Transactions' model handling double-entry accounting operations such as creating transactions, listing transactions with pagination, and retrieving detailed transaction information, including journal entries and account balances.

methods.name: sumAmounts(entries)
methods.description: Helper function that sums up total debit and credit amounts from transaction entries.

methods.name: createTransaction(companyId, { date, description, reference, entries }, client)
methods.description: Creates a new double-entry transaction, inserts journal entries, and updates account balances atomically.

methods.name: listTransactions(companyId, { page = 1, limit = 50, start_date, end_date })
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of transactions with optional date filtering.

methods.name: getTransaction(companyId, transactionId)
methods.description: Fetches a specific transaction along with its journal entries and account details.

ctags.name: createTransaction
ctags.pattern: /^async function createTransaction(companyId, { date, description, reference, entries }, client) {$/

ctags.name: listTransactions
ctags.pattern: /^async function listTransactions(companyId, { page = 1, limit = 50, start_date, end_date }) {$/
